sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished high-quality unique CLEAN BACKGROUND PLATE for portrait4:5 jigsaw puzzle illustration "A young goat in a flower-filled pasture". Premium cozy travel-game storybook digital painting matching approved Art Direction V2 gameplay art: tactile subtly brushed surfaces, fine hand-painted detail, believable dimensional objects, gentle upper-left sunlight, rich color separation and small discoveries. NOT flat vector, NOT photorealistic, NOT generic procedural art. A charming young cocoa-brown goat in a flower-filled pasture, close enough that its fluffy brown coat and warm brown barn background dominate the frame. Copper and ivory meadow flowers, restrained greenery; expressive natural animal anatomy. No people. Real plants and fence anchors, no insects yet. Viewpoint: gently elevated three-quarter view. The picture must fill the entire portrait4:5 canvas, ideal1280x1600; no borders, text, UI, grid, title, logo, watermark or transparent holes. This is a complete naturally composed environment with real stable anchors for five small moving details later added as separate alpha layers. Do not add floating decorative particles or overlay patterns. Preserve coherent scale and perspective. No famous destination landmark. Keep the requested main color visible throughout the scene, not only a tiny accent.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production RGBA transparent sprite atlas of five unique painted details belonging to the scene "A young goat in a flower-filled pasture". Match a premium cozy illustrated puzzle: rich dimensional storybook digital painting, subtle brushed pigment, believable natural forms, fine detail, soft upper-left sun, coherent warm light and tactile materials. No flat vector, no photos, no generic geometric particles. EXACTLY five isolated objects, strict3 columns by2 rows, landscape3:2 canvas. Leave the sixth bottom-right cell perfectly empty transparent. TRUE alpha transparency, no matte, no background, no grid or cell borders, no frame, no shadow rectangle, no labels or text. Place each entire object inside the central50% of its own cell, leaving wide25% gutters on every side. FULL complete loops, stems, wings, wisps and thin strands must fit safely inside each cell; none may touch canvas or cell edges. Top row left to right: one bright orange calendula flower on a slender green stem with two leaves; a slender white clover blossom stem with small three-lobed leaves; a curved oat-grass stalk with warm tan seed heads and a narrow bottom base. Bottom row left to right: one small russet-orange butterfly with softly scalloped wings, viewed from three-quarter angle; one short leafy apple twig with fresh medium-green leaves and a fine bottom stem; EMPTY. Preserve detailed painted alpha edges and translucent material where specified. Do not include containers, scenery or extra items. All five details are real meaningful parts of this specific scene, sharing its scale and light.

authoring.visualReviewNotes: Reviewed final master and original details against the approved painted game style. Calendula, clover and oats grow in the pasture; butterfly is clear of goat face; apple twig joins the background tree. No goat anatomy is covered. Actual palette sample is [550, 660, 1060, 1260] in1280x1600 source space; no landmark observed. Implementation art review only, not PM approval.
